trust.disclaimer: GovBot is an AI assistant, not an official body. Answers can be wrong or outdated. Check important details with the responsible agency.
trust.onboard1Body: It explains public services in Uzbekistan in plain language and points you to the official source.
trust.onboard2Body: AI can make mistakes. Fees, deadlines and documents can change — confirm them with the agency or on my.gov.uz before acting.
trust.onboard3Body: Do not type passport numbers, PINFL, card numbers or phone numbers. GovBot masks them before sending a question to the AI provider, but it is safer not to share them.
trust.ungrounded: No verified catalog material matched this question. Treat this answer as general orientation only.

landing.lead: GovBot is a public-services helper for everyone in Uzbekistan. From passports to business, in your own language.
landing.sampleQ: Where do I apply for a pension?
landing.sampleA: You apply through my.gov.uz or at the nearest service centre. I prepared the list of documents you need.
landing.everyoneTitle: For everyone. No one is left out.
landing.everyoneLead: From students to pensioners, from entrepreneurs to visitors — everyone finds an answer.
landing.citizenText: Passport, ID card, registration, marriage, a child's birth.
landing.youthText: First passport, certificates, military registration, studies.
landing.elderText: Pensions, benefits, healthcare. Large type and spoken answers.
landing.businessText: Opening a sole proprietorship or LLC, taxes, licences.
landing.accessTitle: Hard to read? Just say it.
landing.accessVoice: Ask by voice and listen to the answer
landing.accessNote: Voice input and read-aloud work when your browser supports them.
landing.regionsLead: One helper for the whole country. Wherever you are, the answer is one question away.
landing.step1Text: Type or speak — in Uzbek, Russian or English.
landing.step2Text: Steps, a document list and a link to the official source.
landing.step3Text: Tick off documents and add the deadline to your calendar as a reminder.
landing.closingLead: Answers grounded in official sources — in your language.
landing.closingLeadFree: The first three questions are free, no sign-up.

about.h1: Talking to government — simple, clear, for everyone.
about.lead: GovBot is an AI assistant that shows citizens, residents and visitors a clear path through public services.
about.problemHead: The information exists. It is just hard to find.
about.p1Text: Rules live across dozens of sites and documents — it is hard to know which one you need.
about.p2Text: Official texts are full of legal terms — a simple question gets no simple answer.
about.p3Text: Older people, foreigners and rare internet users are left behind.
about.solutionHead: One place. One question. A clear path.
about.chatText: Ask in your own words — the answer is grounded in an official source.
about.sampleQ: What do I need to open a sole proprietorship?
about.sampleA: You register online with your passport and ID. Steps and source are below.
about.catalogText: The most asked topics — step by step, in three languages.
about.checklistText: Tick what is ready and what is left — add the deadline to your calendar.
about.pipelineLead: Every answer goes through five stages. Not a guess — a source.
about.s1Text: Typed or spoken, in any language
about.s2Text: Passport, PINFL and phone numbers are masked
about.s3Text: Across the official catalog and sources
about.s4Text: The AI writes the steps in plain language
about.s5Text: A link, a document list, a calendar reminder
about.pr1Text: my.gov.uz, gov.uz, lex.uz — a link in every answer.
about.pr2Text: Personal numbers are masked. Guest mode stores nothing.
about.pr3Text: When unsure it does not guess — it points you to the competent body.
about.pr4Text: The core features are free for everyone.
about.r1Text: AI chat, catalog, 3 languages, document lists.
about.r2Text: iOS and Android, push reminders, voice, offline catalog.
about.r3Text: Sign-in with OneID, a Telegram bot, links with government portals.
about.r4Text: Nearest service centre, queues and local rules.
about.ctaLead: A six-step visual guide — in one minute.

guide.lead: From a phone or a computer, in any language.
guide.leadFree: The first three questions need no sign-up.
guide.g1Text: In simple words. The microphone button is for a spoken question.
guide.g2: Get the steps and the source
guide.g2Text: The chips under an answer link to the official site or the catalog.
guide.g3Text: Tick the ones you have — the bar shows how many are left.
guide.g4Text: Do not miss a deadline — pick a date and the reminder lands in your calendar.
guide.g5Text: Language, large type, plain language and read-aloud — in one place.
guide.g6: Sign in to keep your chats
guide.g6Text: Email and password — half a minute. Your chats stay in your account.
guide.phInput: How do I renew my pass...
guide.installText: GovBot opens from your home screen like a separate app, and the catalog can be read offline.
guide.installIos: In Safari tap Share at the bottom of the screen, then choose “Add to Home Screen”.
guide.installOther: In your browser menu choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”.
